search_query.description: the paper-search query for the direction: words joined with `+`, a phrase inside double quotes; a paper must contain every word and phrase

status.description: agent-owned: `active` directions are listed; a `retired` one fell below the leave bar of the selection rule, is kept with its text and comes back when its keywords qualify again; a record without the field is active

quotes.description: agent-owned: the spans of the source abstracts the model-written text rests on. One span per sentence, in sentence order, when the writer's prompt version (`review.prompt_versions.writer`) is 2.0.0 or later; a single span for the whole text before that. Only on a record whose text a model wrote

origin.description: agent-owned: the OpenAlex keywords the direction stands for; written once, when the direction is first listed

keyword_ids.description: short OpenAlex keyword IDs, the one that names the direction first; `https://openalex.org/keywords/<id>` is the keyword's page

keyword_names.description: the keywords as OpenAlex displays them, in the order of `keyword_ids`

first_seen.description: the day the direction was first tied to its keywords

selection.description: agent-owned: the OpenAlex work counts of the direction's keywords and the runs spent below the leave bar, written by code; absent until the first run of the rule. The rule's thresholds are the `directions` setting of the `research-curation` job in the consumer's `config/jobs.yaml`; a record does not repeat them

works_recent.description: arXiv-primary works carrying one of `origin.keyword_ids`, published in the latest window; a work with two of the keywords counts twice, and a keyword outside OpenAlex's 200 largest counts as 0

works_previous.description: the same count in the window before

field_recent.description: every arXiv-primary work of the counted OpenAlex topics in the latest window

field_previous.description: the same count in the window before

window_days.description: length of each counted window in days

leave_after_runs.description: runs in a row below the leave bar that retire the direction, as of the latest run; `runs_below` is read against it

runs_below.description: runs in a row the direction was below the leave bar, as of the latest run

observed_at.description: the day the counts were read; refreshed only when a figure changed

activity.description: agent-owned: arXiv paper counts for `search_query` and the verdict they gave, written by code; absent until the first count. The rule's thresholds are the `hot_directions` setting of the `research-curation` job in the consumer's `config/jobs.yaml`; a record does not repeat them

papers_recent.description: papers matching `search_query` submitted in the latest window

papers_previous.description: the same count in the window before

field_recent.description: every paper of the counted arXiv categories in the latest window, the field the direction is compared with

field_previous.description: the same count in the window before

window_days.description: length of each counted window in days

is_hot.description: the verdict of the hot rule on these counts, as of the day they were read

observed_at.description: the day the counts were read; refreshed only when a figure changed

source.description: the arXiv API address that gave `papers_recent`; it states the query, the categories and the window
